comment: Pinned OpenFlux core used by opffk, built and published by the node-release workflow of the pinned repository. URLs and SHA-256 verified against that release on 2026-10-24. installer and backend refuse any binary whose hash differs.

upstream_verify.method: SHA256SUMS published with the release; the fork's node-release workflow additionally verifies its build against the pins in deploy/node-install.sh of p1neappleXpress/OpenFlux (same values — the fork tagged the same source commit the upstream node-v1.3.1 core was built from)
